name: Chicken Sajji
description: Balochistan-inspired whole roasted chicken with a simple salt-and-spice seasoning, cooked until juicy inside and beautifully roasted outside.
ingredients: 2 tbsp cooking oil or melted butter
method: Pat the chicken dry and make a few shallow cuts in the thickest parts.
Mix lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, salt, pepper, cumin and coriander and rub over the chicken.
Roast on a grill, rotisserie or in a hot oven until the chicken is fully cooked and browned.
Brush lightly with oil or butter during the final stage of roasting.
Rest for 10 minutes, then serve hot with lemon wedges and rice or naan.
